limitations.note: The defect was that `number` did not sample the pre-edge value of `num` alongside `zero`; loading the next count directly still makes `number` appear one clock too early.
The rewrite changed the asynchronous reset value of `zero` from 0 to 1 and replaced its pre-edge count comparison with a next-count comparison.
The passing test expected the loaded value on the same edge that captured `set_num`, so it validated the rewrite’s timing instead of checking that the output reports the pre-edge count.

limitations.quote: The comparison samples the count before the edge
limitations.note: The agent read a relevant note about pre-edge sampling, but that lesson did not carry through to the patch or the test expectations.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: Bundling the file edit and simulation into a command with a prohibited cleanup trap caused the entire command to be rejected and reissued.
